oneOf.description: Fields to fetch. This may also be a structure of type field_aliases_caselaw, rather than an array, in which case the fields will be renamed.

items.description: Fields to fetch. This may also be a structure of type field_aliases_caselaw, rather than an array, in which case the fields will be renamed.

OFFSET.description: How many items to skip at the beginning (for pagination)

QUERY.description: Either a query_body_caselaw object or an array of one or more query_body_caselaw objects separated by strings consisting of boolean operators.

query_body_caselaw.description: Query objects of this type may be freely interleaved with boolean operators, as strings. Available boolean operators are AND and OR

VALUE.description: Field value to match (based on operator)
